notes.title: HORDE MODE UPDATE | 1-4 PLAYERS
notes.content:
Get ready for the ultimate survival challenge! ⚔️🧟‍♂️⚡️

Horde Mode has arrived in Death Horizon: Reloaded, bringing relentless waves of zombies and non-stop action. Face the undead alone or team up with up to 4 players for an even greater fight for survival.

The longer you last, the deadlier the horde becomes!

[previewyoutube=4cw2K1VC4PY;full][/previewyoutube]

💀  Endless waves of zombies – the fight never stops!
🔫  Play solo or call your squad (1-4 players) – teamwork makes survival easier… and way more fun!
🪓  A full arsenal at your disposal – wield firearms or melee weapons and adapt to stay alive.
🔥  And the best part? This update is 100% FREE for all existing players!

Think you can withstand the horde? Jump in now!

notes.title: Major game update + Halloween theme
notes.content:
In this update, we have introduced brand-new weapons, expanded the game's settings, enabled cross-play between PC, Meat Quest, and Pico, implemented numerous game enhancements, and resolved various bugs.

New weapons:

- Added new edged and bladed weapons: knives, machete, axe, pickaxe...
- Added chainsaw.

New settings:

- Added the possibility to play in sitting mode.
- Introduced a left-handed mode.
- Included the option to change the gun angle.
- Implemented the ability to hold weapons without continuously pressing a button.
- Added the option to turn off blood effects.

Improvements:

- Improved the functionality of melee weapons.
- Improved FPS stability and reduced FPS drops.
- Achieved smoother zombie animations.
- Updated bHaptics to the latest version.

Bug fixes:

- Fixed several bugs in the co-op game.
- Improved puzzle work in Scene 5.
- Made UI fixes in the main menu
- And some other bug fixes and improvements

If you come across any bugs in the game or have ideas on how we can enhance your gaming experience, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at info@dream-dev.com.

notes.title: New Big Game Update: October 19, 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44027420/db9ad5e7858a04c193968db3bbc1e96672c98355.png[/img]

[b]We are thrilled to announce a major game update packed with exciting improvements![/b]

In this update, we have introduced brand-new weapons, expanded the game's settings, enabled cross-play between PC, Meat Quest, and Pico, implemented numerous game enhancements, and resolved various bugs.

[b]New weapons:[/b]

- Added new edged and bladed weapons: knives, machete, axe, pickaxe...
- Added chainsaw.

[b]New settings:[/b]

- Added the possibility to play in sitting mode.
- Introduced a left-handed mode.
- Included the option to change the gun angle.
- Implemented the ability to hold weapons without continuously pressing a button.
- Added the option to turn off blood effects.

[b]Improvements:[/b]

- Improved the functionality of melee weapons.
- Improved FPS stability and reduced FPS drops.
- Achieved smoother zombie animations.
- Updated bHaptics to the latest version.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

- Fixed several bugs in the co-op game.
- Improved puzzle work in Scene 5.
- Made UI fixes in the main menu
- And some other bug fixes and improvements

If you come across any bugs in the game or have ideas on how we can enhance your gaming experience, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at info@dream-dev.com.
